tools.name: car_find_business
tools.description: Reads a request and says which category and safety tier it falls in, and whether checked businesses that fit are signed up near the place. When the kind of business is unclear it returns needsDetail with a question and choices for the person. Contacts no one and returns no contact details. No sign-i

tools.name: car_send_request
tools.description: Starts a request for the signed-in person. Needs what they need, where (City, ST), and their consent. Returns a requestId. If CAR is not sure what kind of business it needs, it answers needs_detail with a question and choices and sends nothing; a repeat call with category set to one of those choices

tools.name: car_confirm_person
tools.description: Sends the 6-digit code the person received. When it is right, the request goes to one checked business. Five wrong codes close the request.

tools.name: car_check_status
tools.description: Status of a request: verify_person, matching, offered, accepted, answered, still_looking, or a final state. Final states include the business that accepted, when there is one.

tools.name: car_cancel_request
tools.description: Cancels a request before it goes to a business (while it waits for the text code). After it has gone to a business it cannot be canceled here.

tools.name: car_estimate_services
tools.description: Lists the services the planning estimate covers (house cleaning, bathroom remodel, handyman, plumbing repair, HVAC) with each one's questions and option values, and which CAR categories map to them. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: car_get_estimate
tools.description: A price range for the job researched from local prices (with where the prices came from), not a quote. Contacts no one. Returns an estimateId; an estimateId passed with car_send_request gives the business the same scope and range. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: car_find_outside
tools.description: Only when no signed-up Sirfus business fits the work and place: up to 3 businesses from public listings, each with where it was found, its public phone and website, a rating only when Google gave one, and availability only when known ("we'll confirm a time" otherwise). CAR contacts none of them and

tools.name: car_pick_outside
tools.description: Records the business the person chose. CAR does not contact it or share the person's details; the person contacts it directly. Returns a request (status outside_picked) for status and webhooks.

tools.name: car_set_webhook
tools.description: Registers an https URL that receives a POST on every change of this agent's requests (status and loop stage), signed with the returned secret: CAR-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>. The secret is shown once. Up to 5 per agent.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "car_set_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
